name: Workshop Listing
summary: Passive target-authored workshop summary list composed from canonical Card, Price, Badge, and Button without owning booking behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native unnumbered list emitted only with at least one valid target-authored workshop record.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Direct native list item containing one independently complete workshop summary.

anatomy.name: card
anatomy.description: Native article composed with canonical Card and named by its visible contextual heading.

anatomy.name: image
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Card media region with context-appropriate informative or decorative alternative text.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Canonical Card body containing required title and optional summary metadata.

anatomy.name: date
anatomy.description: Complete target-localized schedule text; use native time only with a corresponding valid machine-readable datetime.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible contextual heading that names the workshop article.

anatomy.name: level
anatomy.description: Optional complete target-authored level, format, or audience text.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Card footer emitted only when price, availability, or action content exists.

anatomy.name: price
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Price composition with a complete target-formatted value.

anatomy.name: spots
anatomy.description: Optional passive canonical Badge with complete visible availability text.

anatomy.name: action
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Button composition; a details destination uses a native anchor and remains distinct from booking behavior.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One canonical intrinsic list/card presentation; target records decide which optional regions are present.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Grid and card anatomy respond to their actual available inline size.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive listing with optional truthful available-status canonical Success Badge.

states.name: lowAvailability
states.description: The availability slot composes canonical Warning Badge with complete target-defined limited-availability text; the threshold is not R7 logic.

states.name: full
states.description: The availability slot composes canonical Error Badge with complete full text; it does not automatically disable a distinct details destination.

behavior.name: semanticCollection
behavior.description: R7 uses native ul/li/article/heading structure in target order with no grid widget role, roving focus, selection model, or whole-card interactive wrapper.

behavior.name: strictRecordOmission
behavior.description: Records without stable identity or non-empty title omit; duplicate identities omit after the first; no valid records omit the complete R7 root.

behavior.name: scheduleTruth
behavior.description: Targets own schedule occurrence, time zone, localization, cancellation and freshness. Native time requires visible content and a corresponding valid datetime; R7 never calculates or reformats dates.

behavior.name: canonicalComposition
behavior.description: Surface/media/body/footer, formatted price, passive status and action semantics remain owned by canonical Card, Price, Badge and Button rather than parallel R7 implementations.

behavior.name: availabilityBoundary
behavior.description: Targets own capacity, thresholds, waitlists, status freshness and any announcement. Static fixture Badges are not live regions, and Full does not by itself determine whether details navigation is available.

behavior.name: destinationBoundary
behavior.description: Details navigation uses a native anchor with descriptive context. Registration, reservation, authentication, payment, cancellation, errors and confirmation require a separately owned target workflow.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: R7 owns no listener, observer, request, timer, controlled/uncontrolled store, focus movement, live region, persistence, booking state, animation, or neutral JavaScript.

properties.name: workshops
properties.description: Required non-empty target-owned ordered workshop-card composition using canonical parts without a prescribed CMS, event, capacity, or booking model.

accessibility: Preserve native ul > li > article collection semantics and associate every article with its visible contextual heading.
Use native time only with a valid datetime that corresponds to the complete visible localized schedule; keep time zone and cancellation context visible when needed.
Give informative media a concise context-appropriate alternative and decorative or fully redundant media an empty alternative; never derive alt text mechanically from the title.
Compose canonical Price for complete target-formatted commerce content and canonical passive Badge for availability; keep all meaning in visible text rather than color alone.
Use native anchors for details navigation and keep the visible label inside the accessible name; do not use a no-op button or make the whole card clickable around nested controls.
Do not automatically disable details navigation when availability is Full; a target-owned booking action may have a different independently verified unavailable state.
Keep static availability out of live regions. A target that refreshes capacity owns announcement timing, deduplication, errors, and user context.
Preserve canonical Card and Button focus/motion behavior, logical source order, full wrapping, RTL, text enlargement, forced colors, and keyboard navigation.

web.notes: Native list/articles/time/link plus canonical Card, Price, Badge and Button composition in components/css/ceramics.css with zero R7 JavaScript.

shopify.notes: Requires approved workshop resource/metaobject, schedule/time-zone/locale, price/capacity freshness, destination/booking service, editor validation and first consumer.

webflow.notes: CMS supplies ordered complete records and real destinations; canonical source CSS is copied by the existing target pipeline.
